# Gemus — DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin

Connect the Gemus design canvas from the official DeepSeek Harness app.
This bundle includes a Host
connection owner and an in-app configuration page. It uses DSH's official MCP client; tools keep the
ir `mcp__gemus__*` names.
## Desktop setup (recommended)

Requires the official DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.5** and a Gemus account.
Download the official app.
The
app includes its runtime; no system Node.js, global CLI, or terminal is required.

1. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:Gemus-AI/gemus-dsh-plugin`.
2. Install an

d enable Gemus, then open its page in the installed plugins list.
3. Choose **Domestic** (`gemus.cn`
) or **International** (`gemus.ai`) in the plugin. Create a Key on that site, paste it into **Gemus
Key**, and connect. Confirm the displayed actual site, account and personal space. An optional expec

ted account ID is checked for equality; it never grants access.
4. In a normal DSH chat, ask: “Use G
emus workflow_list to list workflows in my personal space. Do not create workflows or generate conte
workflow_list to list workflows in my personal space. Do not create workflows or generate content.”
A successful check confirms identity and observed tool registration at the shown time, not continuou
s online status. A normal chat call verifies actual use. Connection checks spend no Gemus generation
credits; DSH chat may consume model credits. Model credentials and working-directory selection belo
ng to DSH and remain separate.
Version 0.2.5 verifies the destination and authenticated site/account before saving or mounting tool
s, including after reopening. New Keys use `mak_cn_…` or `mak_global_…`; strict legacy Keys belong o
nly to International. The connection is saved by DSH's credentials service and restored only after s
uccessful identity verification. Failed checks preserve the credential for retry and do not mount to
ols. Older International servers are compatible only with strict legacy-global Keys; Domestic and ta
gged Keys require the new identity response. This local storage is not an encrypted keychain and doe
s not protect secrets from other processes running as the same OS user.
## Recovery and upgrade
Use **Check again** after a network failure or exhausted automatic retries. It rebuilds one official
MCP instance and checks again. Use **Change Key** for the wrong account or a revoked Key. **Disconn
ect** clears this plugin's stored Key and prevents legacy environment fallback; it does not revoke a
Gemus Key or alter other clients.
From 0.1.3, use the native Plugins page to uninstall and reinstall, then enter your Key again. Keep
your models, chats, and other plugins. Unknown user YAML overrides are not automatically removed; a
conflicting Gemus MCP row must be resolved through the host's existing management UI. No build scrip
ts or allowBuilds grant are needed.
Windows and macOS require separate end-to-end verification. Other DSH releases are outside this vers
ion's declared compatibility.
## Advanced CLI setup
The existing published installer below is an International legacy path and has no installation ident
ity preflight. Domestic users should use Desktop or the explicit manual environment below. It requir
es Node.js and a `dsh` command on PATH:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It configures the **web** CLI profile, not Desktop. Alternatively:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For International use its own Key and `https://gemus.ai/api/mcp`. In PowerShell set both `$env:GEMUS
_KEY = "mak_cn_…"` and `$env:GEMUS_URL = "https://gemus.cn/api/mcp"` before launching `dsh --profile
web` in that same terminal. Child processes inherit the current shell environment. Updating the Win
dows user environment or a shell startup file requires a new terminal.
Legacy `GEMUS_KEY` / `GEMUS_URL` are read together only when no desktop credential record exists. `G
EMUS_URL` is the full MCP URL; the default is `https://gemus.ai/api/mcp`. Supported destinations are
official Gemus HTTPS port 443 `/api/mcp` endpoints and explicit localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1] devel
opment `/api/mcp` endpoints. Unknown hosts, other paths/official ports, URL credentials, query and f
ragment are rejected before sending a Key. Redirects are refused. Local development is global-only.
The next CLI source release adds installation preflight and optional `--expected-user <account ID>`.
Its launched session carries a one-use setup intent and the verified account ID; the Host verifies
again and updates the existing DSH credential through the connection owner. This makes an explicit s
etup replace a previously saved connection without changing ordinary environment precedence or the d
isconnect tombstone. Setup-intent fields are removed from the Host environment and are never persist
ed in shell profiles or user environment. It must be published from merged master and verified befor
e updating live installer pins; this PR does not publish or point users to an unavailable package.
Use `dsh --profile web --dump-config` to inspect the Gemus layer. For reproducibility, pin `github:G
emus-AI/gemus-dsh-plugin#<published-sha>`.
## What the agent gets
| Tool | Purpose |

| `edit` | Plan operations, multi-node graphs, focused edits and capability-backed imports |
| `read

` | Canvas, node/model contract, assets, figures, history and PPT read targets |
| `execute` | Run o

ne or several nodes, then deliver content, renew leases or report client failures |
| `view_image` |

View produced images as pixels |
| `workflow_list`, `open_canvas` | Resolve and open an existing wo

rkflow |
| `search`, `fetch` | Discover and read community work |
| `ppt_edit`, `publish_workflow` |
Deck authoring and confirmed publishing |
Writes require an explicit idempotencyKey. Use the same key only for an identical retry. Read item s
tatus and resource identities; execute.wait reports current progress. ask_user_question is available
only in Bridge mode.
